Grit tab bhi rukna hai jab dard ho.
Ek dhairya-wan insaan ke gusse se bach kar raho.
Dil ki khamoshi mein, bhagwan baat karta hai.
Mahaan dimaag vicharon par, aam dimaag ghatnaon par, aur chhote dimaag logon par baatchaat karte hain.
Grit sabse bade toofan ko maat deti hai.
Pressure me steady raho.
Grit persistence ki habit hai.
Saahas woh hai jab darr se marna ho, phir bhi savari karna.
Courage—fear ka na hona nahi, uske bawajood act karne ki ability.
Himmat, dar ka muqabla karna hai.
Shaant logon ke dimaag shor karte hain.
Khamoshi anant jitni gehri hai.
Bada hona aur asli banta—courage lagta.
Khamoshi sach ko ubharne deti.
Bahaduri darr ka na hona nahi hai.
Khamoshi ko suno. Iske paas kehne ko bahut kuch hai.
Himmat uthna hai.
